latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Make Three.js location-based examples available on iPhone by @ma2yama in https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/pull/659
* Support for navigator in Safari on iPad with iOS 13 or later by @ma2yama in https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/pull/660
* Fix Prettier configuration file name by @ma2yama in https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/pull/662
* Enable altitude by @ma2yama in https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/pull/671
* Upgrade dependencies and implement simple-git-hooks for linting by @kalwalt in https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/pull/682


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/compare/3.4.7...3.4.8
